connectors.premise: No CT scanner exposes an API to be driven through. It asks — over DICOM, at the start of a shift — for the work scheduled on it, and whoever answers decides what appears on the technologist’s screen. Samaam is that answer. The device is not modified, updated, or replaced.

notes.fhir: Read-only. Pulls the patient and their latest serum creatinine. The name, contact and address fields are never read.
notes.mwl: Samaam answers the scanner’s C-FIND itself. Every entry is evaluated first: a blocked study is not served, so it never appears in the worklist — and both outcomes are written to the audit trail.
notes.modality: Filled in by the first query that reaches the server, not typed by hand.
notes.injector: Volume, flow rate and iodine load are enforced by the policy node.
